title: Preserve existing cards and codes during UI work
trigger: UI change in the loyalty-card wallet
observed_problem: User explicitly excluded QR/barcode/scanner/storage from visual tasks
approach_that_failed: Scope creep into protected data/code flows
effective_approach: Limit diff and verify existing cards/data after UI change
exceptions: Change protected flows only in a separately authorized task
prevention_rule: Preserve card data and QR/barcode/scanner/storage unless explicitly authorized

title: Static checks do not verify deployment or phone behavior
observed_problem: Static checks coexisted with old Pages UI and unverified device flows
approach_that_failed: Treating source checks as proof of live deployment
effective_approach: Verify source commit, publication source, live URL, phone runtime and key interactions
exceptions: A static check can only establish the property it tests
prevention_rule: Report source, deployment, runtime and regression statuses separately

title: Reproduce scanner, gallery and crop regressions independently
trigger: Several UI paths reported broken after changes
observed_problem: Scanner hang, gallery import failure and crop reposition regression were reported
approach_that_failed: Assigning one cause to several unverified symptoms
effective_approach: Reproduce each flow, inspect handler/state/render path, then run adjacent regressions
exceptions: Do not infer cause from commit names alone
prevention_rule: Track each user-visible path with its own reproduction and acceptance evidence

title: A requested brand catalog is not proof of integrated templates
observed_problem: A branch and commit were mentioned but complete integration was not verified
approach_that_failed: Claiming completion from branch/commit mention alone
effective_approach: Compare actual catalog to accepted brand list and test adding a template while preserving existing cards
exceptions: Do not assume every listed brand exists in the final build
prevention_rule: Verify catalog contents and real add-template behavior against the full list

title: A storage read error must not appear as an empty wallet
trigger: Web/PWA storage read or parse fails during UI work
observed_problem: The wallet appeared empty after a JavaScript/storage failure; the source conversation also identified a fallback that converted localStorage read failure into cards=[]
root_cause: The source conversation reported a malformed async declaration that prevented JavaScript execution; deployed source and data recovery were not independently verified in this memory task
approach_that_failed: Treating a read/parse error as an empty array and proceeding as if the user had no cards
effective_approach: Fail closed on storage errors; preserve raw storage, avoid overwriting data, create a backup and verify recovery before continuing
evidence_refs: Raw export conversation 6ac3c8f4-c55c-83ed-8f87-61017faf4c9d; user messages bbb217b2-c535-4146-b73d-b78423a23692 and bbb2107b-efcc-44bd-b6fe-4a6fe6e834f3
applicability: CARD111 Web/PWA storage and similar user-data stores
exceptions: Do not claim data is recovered until reload/backup restoration is actually verified
prevention_rule: Storage read/parse failure must not silently become an empty database or trigger a destructive write

title: Preserve symbology together with the decoded value
trigger: QR/barcode data is scanned, stored or rendered
observed_problem: The camera could show a code without saving it; a separate source chain reports that a QR_CODE result was stored/displayed as digits without preserving its format
root_cause: End-to-end code-format handling was not independently verified here
approach_that_failed: Guessing QR versus barcode from the number or composition of digits, or treating visible camera video as successful decode
effective_approach: Store raw decoded value and detected symbology together; preserve them through save/reload and render with the matching QR/barcode encoder
applicability: CARD111 scanner, card persistence and code rendering
exceptions: Confirm format support and acceptance separately for each scanner library and target platform
prevention_rule: Verify decode → format/value preservation → save → reload → render as one explicit test chain
